name: Guard Jagdish
dialogue: Namaste, new student! Welcome to the University of Hyderabad (HCU).
If you're looking for your admissions desk, head straight south down this road to the Administration Building (Building 1) or Pariksha Bhavan (43).
Don't forget to explore our beautiful campus! There are 5 lakes and magnificent ancient rocks like Mushroom Rock to discover.

name: Senior Scholar Ananya
dialogue: Hey there, fresher! Congratulations on getting admitted to UoH!
Tip from a senior: Always keep your Campus Discovery Book handy (press 'J'). Every time you find a building, lake, or rock, you earn exploration points!
If you need a break between lectures, check out Zakir Complex (Food Court 27) for some delicious chai!

name: Prof. Sharma
dialogue: Welcome to the School of Computer Science & Information Sciences!
We build world-class AI models and distributed networks here.
Step inside our interactive lab classroom anytime to test your skills in the 5-question pop quiz!

name: Prof. Rao
dialogue: Greetings! This is the School of Management Studies (SMS).
We prepare future leaders in strategy, marketing, healthcare, and analytics.
Feel free to enter the classroom and attempt our Business Strategy quiz!

name: Librarian Radhika
dialogue: Welcome to the Indira Gandhi Memorial Library.
We house over 400,000 reference books, journals, and digital research terminals.
Step inside to enjoy peaceful study reading or take our campus heritage quiz!

name: Coach Vikram
dialogue: Great to see you at the athletics pavilion!
A healthy body fosters a sharp mind. We have running tracks, football pitches, tennis courts, and a gym.
Take a lap around the stadium to build up your stamina!

name: Raju Bhai
dialogue: Bhaiya! Welcome to the famous South Night Canteen!
When the clock strikes 10:00 PM, we serve the crispiest samosas, hot Irani chai, and spicy midnight Maggi.
Come hang out with scholars and recharge after a long day of classes!

name: Warden Murali
dialogue: Welcome to MHK Hostel (Hostels L & M). Your room is ready on the ground floor!
Whenever you are tired after night activities, come inside your room and hop into bed.
Sleeping advances time to the next morning and saves your game progress automatically.
